node.statement: For every admissible package furnished by lem-stage1-bound-quotient-local-index and each s in {+1,-1}, sJ is the unique sigma-fixed point in the ambient ball calU intersect B_{r_iso}(sJ). Taking r_bidx:=r_iso (which is positive and depends only on W) therefore supplies exactly the remaining conclusions of node 1.
